fact: The sixth coordination meeting of state information centre directors, held by the National Information Centre on 22 November 2022, recommended directing Sudatel to deliver fibre at once to the localities and bodies that ask for it, the beneficiary body paying, and strengthening the states' network with the telecom companies while lowering the cost of internet.
title: الإجتماع التنسيقي السادس لمديري مراكز معلومات الولايات
